# Kestrel — source record

- **Origin:** the supplied experimental intake already in the Robot Lab experimental registry (CrispStrobe, BSD-3-Clause), reviewed natively before promotion.
- **Adaptations (made at intake, unchanged here):** the licence line points at the packaged licence. Geometry and program are unchanged.
- **Law (`crank-rocker-v1`):** a Grashof crank-rocker (16/48/32/48 mm); the passive rocker pin follows the four-bar closure |B−A| = c, |B−C| = k from the observed crank, and swings through the toggle-position prediction.
- **Disconnection** (`coupler` removed): the only link joining crank pin A to rocker pin B; the rocker pin leaves the closure (measured 64 mm, loss needs > 2 mm).
